files.prefill_tps_note: R-270 AC1 prefill_tps per chat model key (K-NEW-FILES-2, A-M6-T02a): median of build/perf/raw chat-*/inproc-* runs with >= 1k prompt tokens on the build Mac; unmeasured keys scale by parameter count from the nearest measured one.
files.prefill_tps_tier_default_note: A-M6-T02a lead decision: a chat key missing above (e.g. after a catalog model update) or a non-positive value uses this conservative per-tier rate (below every measured default model of the tier), so the rule leans to excerpts instead of a slow inline prefill.
files.duckdb_note: M6.T07 [ASSUMPTION] (R-272): per-chat in-memory DuckDB memory_limit (MB) and the sheet profile block cap (tokens).

search.source: blueprint B §B1.6 (queries, evidence_tokens, reranker), §B1.2 step 4 (pages = top K fetched), §B1.2 step 3 (free_race_budget_s = the 2.5 s engine timeout) [ASSUMPTION, owner Phase 6/7]; A-M7-04; evidence_tokens T3 kept at 10000 (M9.T05: 3000 met AT-254 but dropped AT-250 c2 T3 to 0.888 on held-out-5; the T3 latency fix is the harness-written forced search call, WebSearchTools.directSearchTiers)
search.fetch_deadline_s_note: M9.T05 (AT-254 T3 first token, cold page caches): the turn answers with the pages fetched by this many seconds after the fetch starts; a later page is used as its search snippet and its fetch finishes in the background into the page cache. A tier without a cell waits for every page (5 s page timeout). T3 tuned on 2 x 20 cold turns each (search-availability rows 21-40, private page caches): first token p50 4.23 s at 1.0 s vs 4.89 s at 1.5 s vs 6.08 s without (build/at/AT-254/t3-deadline/).
